import sys

def main():
    k2, k3, k5, k6 = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())

    cnt256 = min(k2, k5, k6)
    k2 -= cnt256

    cnt32 = min(k2, k3)

    ans = cnt256 * 256 + cnt32 * 32
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
